hook.text: This video cost zero dollars. Here are the five free tools behind it.

item0.text: Number five: Kokoro. A free voice model small enough to run on a laptop.

item1.text: Number four: GSAP. The animation engine. Free, even for commercial work.

item2.text: Number three: whisper dot C P P. It listens back and checks every word.

item3.text: Number two: HyperFrames. It turns plain HTML into real video.

item4.text: And number one: F F M Peg. It mixes the audio and encodes every frame.
